title: EOPatch and AAPS Erros
symptom: After changing the EOPatch pump, the user could no longer access the configuration of DYNISF and AAPS kept crashing. Switching to the virtual pump allowed normal operation, suggesting an error with the EOPatch.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/fa2b9bddcceee6c9dc071e6055d8ff365d5b6e0b
